// Fixture: the marker pasted into a handler. The waiver is scoped to internal/session/, so this is
// two violations at once — the datastore import, and a waiver its author believed was granting
// something.
package handler

//arch:allow-session-store we also keep some state here
import "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

func Client(addr string) *redis.Client {
	return redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{Addr: addr})
}
